Name: Haley as Princess Peach
Author: WickedyWoah
Description:
[center]﻿[size=5]﻿Hey, Hi, Howdy, and Hello[/size][/center]I recently tried out a "super " fun challenge farm, turning Toad into a Mushroom King. With it, I had the objective to marry the princess, so I turned Haley into Princess Peach! (just visually, she goes by Haley in the game due to like, witness protection program stuff or whatever. DON'T tell Bowser that she's in hiding in Pelican Town!)


[img]https://i.imgur.com/S86EN3n.png[/img]

The portraits are crafted from Princess Peach images from the game ﻿"Super Princess Peach" which is a Nintendo DS game released in 2006. I did my best to clean them up in a way that fits. 

The sprite sheet is just a custom recolor and remake of Haley into the Princess she is in her heart.

[b]PERMISSIONS: [/b]If you want to fix up the portraits in this mod, please feel free! I did my best
